_doc: kind: active|passive|movement|shared-passive. input keys per version. cost/cooldown/duration in resource units / seconds. alpha-tree: {column, needs} where needs = points required in previous. alpha-tree column 'ultimate' (D10): 4th column per class holding the steam R skill, unlocked by 5 points in the spec's rank-3 skill. Points: generators.json#design.skill-point. F1 conflicts decided 2026-09-07.

basic-attack.name: Basic Attack
basic-attack.effect: weapon M1 moveset; builds combo and MP (non-mage)

special-attack.name: Special Attack
special-attack.effect: weapon M2 moveset; warrior/ranger/mage charge (MP bar pink), rogue instant; more MP = more damage + stun/knockdown chance

dodge-roll.name: Dodge Roll
dodge-roll.effect: i-frames (not vs spike traps / dagger poison); dismounts; negates fall damage; up to 5 chained if regen allows

jump.name: Jump
jump.effect: tap = hop, hold = max; mid-air steering; no i-frames; wall-jump/flip while climbing costs stamina (S 0.9.1-3)

climb.name: Climb

cost.stamina: drain; none while still (A); none with climbing spikes (S)

climb.effect: any vertical surface, sideways ok, no overhangs; release = fall (A)

swim.name: Swim / Dive
swim.effect: ≈½ walk speed; A: infinite breath; S: diving breath → HP loss when empty, wall-hold pauses, healing extends

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.effect: light radius by lamp rarity (A) / artifacts (S)

quick-item.name: Use Quick Item
quick-item.effect: food (sit, immobile), potion (channel, can move), bomb (spawn); choose via Tab wheel

call-pet.name: Call / Ride Pet
call-pet.effect: recall or mount; A needs Riding skill; S needs land Reins

deploy-special-item.name: Deploy Glider / Boat
deploy-special-item.effect: glider: space to level off (stamina), attack closes it, collision = dizzy fall, no midair redeploy; boat: only in swim-deep water, surfaces if underwater

block.name: Block
block.effect: absorbs frontal hits; gives MP (D11: the bar specials spend); guardian block power x2

riding.name: Riding
riding.effect: enables mounting (R near pet); +X% mount speed per point

hang-gliding.name: Hang Gliding
hang-gliding.effect: 1st point enables Hang Glider item; further points +glide speed

sailing.name: Sailing
sailing.effect: 1st point enables Boat item; further points +boat speed (GP says needs Climbing 5 ?)

smash.name: Smash
smash.effect: leap to target within range, AoE damage, high stun chance

cyclone.name: Cyclone
cyclone.effect: spin, damage all nearby every 0.25 s (haste ignored); S: blocks all directions with Block Power which regenerates during cyclone; tap = 1 s

cyclone-jump.name: Cyclone Jump
cyclone-jump.effect: launch high, auto-channel 1 s, cannot block during

war-frenzy.name: War Frenzy
war-frenzy.effect: charge specials faster; red tint; points → cooldown + charge rate

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.effect: stun immunity + reduced damage; usable while stunned; points → cooldown + damage reduction

rock-fist.name: Rock Fist
rock-fist.effect: charge in a straight line; knock-up + stun everything hit; cancel with dodge/M2/Smash

heroic-shout.name: Heroic Shout
heroic-shout.effect: taunt all enemies within 5 m (red tint); allies incl. self regen 50% max HP over 10 s

battle-fury.name: Battle Fury
battle-fury.effect: 13% per hit (wiki ~12-14%) → 8 s buff: 50% life steal, specials charge near-instantly; refreshable

berserker-rage.name: Berserker Rage
berserker-rage.effect: +attack speed per hit up to 69% (S); reset on miss

toughness.name: Toughness
toughness.effect: +25% max HP (A, cuwo x1.25; S shipped +25 flat, treated as bug)

barricade.name: Barricade / Elusiveness (guardian)
barricade.effect: block with any weapon; block power doubled / block twice as long

kick.name: Kick
kick.effect: roundhouse/spinning kick, knockback all in melee range, possible KO; points → cooldown + knockback

retreat.name: Retreat
retreat.effect: A: short backward jump away from cursor; S: backflip toward camera, grants max stealth; 2013-07-23 fix: no glide speed boost

aim.name: Aim
aim.effect: lie prone, zoomed view, slowly enter stealth (purple bar): fast MP regen, +damage, +crit; cancelled by movement; points → cooldown + entry speed

scouts-swiftness.name: Scout's Swiftness
scouts-swiftness.effect: +move & attack speed, afterimage; points → cooldown + magnitude; MP crash fixed 2013-07-23

sneak.name: Sneak
sneak.effect: move slower, fill stealth (faster standing still / in darkness, slower in daylight / near lamps)

charge-builds-stealth.name: Charged Shot Stealth
charge-builds-stealth.effect: charging M2 builds stealth; stealth → MP + crit

hit-series.name: Hit Series
hit-series.effect: attack speed (and power ?) up per consecutive hit

intuition.name: Intuition (Rough Ranger)
intuition.effect: A: chance per shot to crit and to get a free fully-charged power shot; S: basic hit may proc 30 s buff: next M2 charges instantly (consumes all MP)

shadow-shooter.name: Shadow Shooter
shadow-shooter.effect: clone mimicking your shots, same HP as you at spawn, deals % of your damage; stats scale since 0.9.1-4

high-jump.name: High Jump
high-jump.effect: ~2x jump height; acts as a dodge (ninja)

quicksand-trap.name: Quicksand Trap
quicksand-trap.effect: zone: enemies inside nearly immobilised and armor/resistance stripped (as if combo built)

fire-explosion.name: Fire Explosion
fire-explosion.effect: self-centred spherical explosion: burn, knockback, stun chance, screen shake; points → damage + knockback

healing-stream.name: Healing Stream
healing-stream.effect: channel then heal large amount (self or targeted ally); heal scales with weapon level; points → mana cost

mana-shield.name: Mana Shield
mana-shield.effect: instant, absorbs damage = % of player HP; cooldown < duration so permanent; fully absorbed hits give no knockback; points → cooldown + absorb

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.effect: A: short cast, move forward ~60 blocks (?), blocked by solids, safe landing; S: to cursor; not through gates (0.9.2-0); distance normalised 0.9.3-0

float.name: Float / Hover
float.effect: slow fall, resets fall damage; spam to stay airborne (bug)

fire-missiles.name: Fire Missiles
fire-missiles.effect: 4 fireballs at cursor, each ≈3x spell power, big AoE, knockdowns

bubbles.name: Bubbles
bubbles.effect: 6 bubbles trail and stick to enemies (and summoned pets), detonate for damage + healing puddles

fire-spark.name: Fire Spark
fire-spark.effect: chance on M1 hit → 30 s buff: next M2 instant and free

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.effect: attack speed per hit, up to 20-hit streak

healing-spells.name: Healing Spells
healing-spells.effect: every spell heals allies and leaves a stacking blue healing puddle

intercept.name: Intercept
intercept.effect: dash to target/cursor then perform weapon M2 on nearby enemies

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.effect: instant full stealth kept while moving and attacking

shuriken-attack.name: Shuriken Attack
shuriken-attack.effect: backflip away from cursor while throwing 5 shuriken at aim; points → cooldown + stealth duration

shuriken-toss.name: Shuriken Toss
shuriken-toss.effect: arcing shuriken, damage scales with weapon, gives MP

ninjutsu.name: Ninjutsu
ninjutsu.effect: M1 = free faster shuriken, M2 = Intercept, no stamina costs

poison-vial.name: Poison Vial
poison-vial.effect: throw arcing vial: green AoE poison

way-of-the-shadows.name: Way of the Shadows
way-of-the-shadows.effect: specials (and dodges) build stealth; full stealth = near-zero aggro

counter-strike.name: Counter Strike (Shadow Strike)
counter-strike.effect: dodge all damage during your M2

elusiveness.name: Elusiveness (Shadow Force)
elusiveness.effect: each dodged attack: +25 MP and 30 s window where next M2 is a guaranteed crit

_omega-signature.zombie-eat: grab, immobilise, drain HP while healing self; armor penetration grows with combo
_omega-signature.slime-divide: below 50% HP split into smaller full-HP copies
_omega-signature._note: Ω creatures get signature abilities; player Ω skills unpublished (2026 tweet: all classes functional, new skills, skill trees next)
